scope: Focused primary-source screen; not a claim of exhaustive novelty

sources.title: Steepest Descent Methods for Multicriteria Optimization
sources.established: Multiobjective steepest/feasible descent directions and Pareto first-order conditions.
sources.boundary: A common-ascent optimization direction is not itself new.

sources.title: Multi-Task Learning as Multi-Objective Optimization
sources.established: MGDA-style multiobjective task gradients and Pareto optimization in deep learning.
sources.boundary: Gradient balancing and a convex-hull diagnostic are established; the L2 vs executable L-infinity geometry must be explicit.

sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
sources.established: PCGrad projects conflicting task gradients onto normal planes.
sources.boundary: Projection is a baseline. A subsequent sign operation is a separate transformation and need not preserve its common-ascent behavior.

sources.title: Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent for Multi-task Learning
sources.established: Worst local task improvement regularizes optimization of average loss; includes MGDA and ordinary gradient descent as special cases.
sources.boundary: Balancing average and worst local improvement is established.

sources.title: Improving Generalization of Universal Adversarial Perturbation via Dynamic Maximin Optimization
sources.established: DM-UAP uses dynamic model-data pairs and max-min-min optimization for universal perturbation generalization.
sources.boundary: Universal attacks with maximin are already occupied; merely switching the RefCloth loss aggregation is insufficient for an independent novelty claim.

possible_distinct_question: Does sign-and-clip execution destroy common source-state ascent for one physical cloth, and can an executable primal LP repair it under actual native PNG export and independent-state validation?
not_claimed: certified native gradient error from finite probes
